text: Sorry to bother you this late, I'm probably overreacting. I'm looking after my niece Lily, she's 4, and she's had a runny stuffy nose and been sneezing all day. Temp is 37.8. When I was getting her changed I noticed some little spots on her tummy and legs, tiny dark red dots and a couple of purplish bits. I think I read somewhere you press a glass on them, so I tried it and I'm fairly sure they didn't go away, you could still see them through the glass. Not sure if I did it right. Her mum's away till tomorrow and I didn't want to ring her and panic her for nothing. Sorry again.
